content.title: Continuous Interior Follow | Wall Thresholds, Repeated Position, Plan Reveal
content.summary: A conservator crosses three archive rooms before an overhead plan reveal. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: One adult identity, direction and pace remain fixed. + Every room change occurs at a visible threshold. + Foreground occlusion preserves rather than resets continuity. + Repeated screen position acts as a temporal clock. + The overhead payoff reveals the accumulated route geometry.
quick_start.recommended_input: Follow one adult museum conservator in a rust coat walking left-to-right through a closed archive floor. Carry her through restoration room, map room and cold store, each entered through a visible threshold. End overhead with the complete archive plan and the same conservator still advancing along that line.
